clues: This city sits in central Myanmar, in a wide river valley. It lies south of Mandalay, on the east bank of the river.
The land here stays dry for much of the year. Strong south winds blow each year from March until September.
Its jail was famed as the worst place for men held for their views. Red Cross staff first won the right to visit in nineteen ninety nine.
A dead volcano hill rises to the south east of town. It is the one big sight in the flat land all around.
This town heads the branch rail line that runs to Thazi. It also sits on the main line from Yangon to Mandalay.
